name: VehicleDamageInspector
tagline: The Vehicle Damage Inspector replaces paper walk-around sheets.
description: The Vehicle Damage Inspector replaces paper walk-around sheets. It shows a top-view drawing of a car, van or pickup. You tap the exact spot where you see damage, choose what kind of damage it is and how serious it is, and add a short note. Every damage item gets a numbered pin on the drawing and a card in the list underneath.
features: A condition score from 0 to 100 with a grade (Excellent, Good, Fair, Poor)
A status line that tells you when the inspection is complete, or which items still need a note
Search, filters (severity, type, new only) and sorting for longer lists
A layout made for phones: the vehicle turns sideways so it fits the screen
